According to the International Energy Agency, reducing the carbon footprint of industrial production by just 1% could save 90 million tons of CO₂ emissions annually. Technologies such as digital twins and accelerated computing are enabling manufacturers to reduce emissions, enhance energy efficiency and meet the growing demand for environmentally conscious production. The company expects to increase manufacturing efficiency while reducing energy consumption by over 30% annually. Join the Siemens and NVIDIA session at the 7X24 Exchange 2024 Fall Conference to discover how digital twins and AI are driving sustainable solutions across data centers .

This target starts at the next executable regular-session OPEN and ends at the fifth session CLOSE, counting entry as one. Do not count the initial overnight or earlier announcement reaction as a future return. We predict RAW price movement, including ordinary market movement, not the article's isolated causal effect.
